items.headline: Phase 3 trial shows cell therapy slows Duchenne muscular dystrophy progression
items.summary: The Lancet published final one-year results from the HOPE-3 trial testing deramiocel in Duchenne muscular dystrophy, showing the therapy slowed upper limb function decline by more than half compared to placebo. Researchers also reported meaningful cardiac benefits, a rare combination in a disease with no cure.
items.why_it_matters: This is the first Phase 3 trial to show a significant functional benefit in a largely non-ambulatory Duchenne population, a major step for a relentless genetic disease.

items.headline: Razorback sucker fish upgraded from endangered to threatened
items.summary: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service finalized the downlisting of the razorback sucker fish from endangered to threatened status. The decision caps more than three decades of recovery work across multiple states, tribes, and agencies along the Colorado and San Juan river basins.
items.why_it_matters: It shows that sustained, multi-decade collaborative conservation efforts can bring a species back from the brink of extinction.
items.source_name: Colorado Parks and Wildlife / North Forty News
